summary: Backend-only verification of S20 complements (5 points). Ran full suite excluding stale test_phase1_survey.py: 94 passed, 2 skipped. Live curl verification confirmed: (1) /relance appends to relances[] without touching status and lead stays in to-call group=2 (covered by test_relance_logs_without_changing_status + rejects by='' and channel='sms' with 400); (2) GET /api/admin/stats returns by_category_status with 4 keys (devis/contact/rachat/entreprise), each with 11 statuses; 'entreprise' is NOT a top-level key and its 24 nouveau leads are correctly EXCLUDED from stats.nouveau (25 = 13+11+1) and stats.total (32); (3) B2B isolation confirmed — POST /api/b2b leads never appear in /api/admin/to-call (0 entreprise items) and /api/admin/demandes/entreprise still returns 400; (4) Injoignable rule now rejects <6 pas_de_reponse calls with 400 'il faut 6 appels' and accepts at exactly 6 (200); (5) /api/admin/notifications/digest-test returned {status:'sent'} with no crash. critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2603 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into modules (routers/, services/, scheduler/) in a future refactor.

get_admin_stats performs N*M count_documents calls (4 categories x 11 statuses + totals = ~48 round-trips); for a small dataset it's fine but consider an aggregation pipeline if lead volume grows.
